reasoning: This was a phase 1/2 combination trial of grapiprant (EP4 antagonist) plus pembrolizumab (PD-1 inhibitor) in post-PD-1/L1 NSCLC patients. The trial failed to meet its primary endpoints of safety/tolerability, recommended phase 2 dose, and objective response rate. With only 18 patients over 7 months average duration, the company terminated the study based on 'totality of combined safety and efficacy data.' No target engagement data, biomarker changes, or efficacy signals are reported. The small sample size (n=18) and early termination suggest either safety concerns or lack of efficacy signal, but without specific safety signals reported, this appears to be primarily an efficacy failure. The combination rationale of EP4 antagonism enhancing PD-1 checkpoint inhibition was not validated clinically.
